summary: At a public meeting a resident wants to know whether the price on the hauler’s bill can change.
realLife: Delaware officials fielded pricing concerns during the rollout and reported that some residents obtained lower prices after contacting haulers.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: hauler invoice and documented price decision.

turns.what: A resident asks the hauler to distinguish its service price from deposits paid at a store.
turns.pulledBy: Both a hauler invoice and a store deposit appear in the household’s expenses.
turns.writesBack: The household can identify which charge it may redeem.

turns.what: After the refund ends, the hauler can still review its service price separately from the statewide beverage fee.
turns.pulledBy: The replacement fee is set by law but the service price can be reviewed.
turns.writesBack: Any price adjustment appears on the hauler’s bill.
